%
% Consolidated links to the formal evidence for each result.
%
% Each paper inputs its own generated file paper/evidence/<paper>.tex, written by
% scripts/paper_evidence.py from the coverage ledger and the Comparator replay
% receipts.  That file holds one line per result,
%
%   \DeclareResultEvidence{<label>}{<mark>}{<Lean URL>}{<Comparator URL>}
%
% plus its record, statement name and evidence status. A result's label binds
% its identity; its Lean and Comparator links appear once in the final
% verification concordance. Missing and duplicate result labels are errors.
% Do not edit the per-paper files by hand.

% Companion-PDF links use the same readable external-link colour in grayscale.
\hypersetup{filecolor=linkexternal}

\makeatletter
\newcommand*{\ev@all}{}
\newcommand*{\ev@rows}{}
\newif\ifev@second
\newif\ifev@newpage
\newcommand{\evidenceconcordancenewpage}{\ev@newpagetrue}
\newcommand{\DeclareResultEvidenceName}[2]{%
  \expandafter\gdef\csname ev@name@#1\endcsname{#2}}
\newcommand{\DeclareResultEvidence}[4]{%
  \ifcsname ev@map@#1\endcsname
    \PackageError{paper-evidence}{Evidence declared twice for label #1}%
      {Regenerate the paper's evidence file with scripts/paper_evidence.py.}%
  \else
    \expandafter\gdef\csname ev@map@#1\endcsname{\ev@marks{#1}{#2}{#3}{#4}}%
    \expandafter\gdef\csname ev@inline@#1\endcsname{\ev@inline{#1}{#2}{#3}{#4}}%
    \g@addto@macro\ev@all{\do{#1}}%
  \fi}
% Generated record targets also cover statements without a complete Lean proof.
% They let an authored inline reference use the very same result identity as
% the heading links, rather than copying a source pin or a declaration coordinate.
\newcommand{\DeclareResultEvidenceRecord}[4]{%
  \expandafter\gdef\csname ev@record@#1\endcsname{#2}%
  \expandafter\gdef\csname ev@leanstatus@#1\endcsname{#3}%
  \expandafter\gdef\csname ev@cmpstatus@#1\endcsname{#4}%
  \g@addto@macro\ev@rows{\ev@row{#1}}}
\newcommand{\ev@inline}[4]{%
  \begingroup\normalfont\scriptsize
  \href{#3}{#2}%
  \if\relax\detokenize{#4}\relax
    \ifcsname ev@cmpstatus@#1\endcsname
      \edef\ev@status{\csname ev@cmpstatus@#1\endcsname}%
      \def\ev@pending{pending}%
      \ifx\ev@status\ev@pending
        \enspace\textperiodcentered\enspace
        \href{\csname ev@record@#1\endcsname-comparator}{Comparator pending}%
      \fi
    \fi
  \else
    \enspace\textperiodcentered\enspace\href{#4}{Comparator}%
  \fi
  \endgroup}
\newcommand{\resultevidence}[1]{%
  \ifcsname ev@inline@#1\endcsname
    \csname ev@inline@#1\endcsname
  \else
    \ifcsname ev@record@#1\endcsname
      \href{\csname ev@record@#1\endcsname}{evidence record}%
    \else
      \PackageError{paper-evidence}{No evidence record for #1}%
        {Use the label of a result recorded by scripts/paper_evidence.py.}%
    \fi
  \fi}
\newcommand{\ev@marks}[4]{%
  \ifcsname ev@placed@#1\endcsname\else
    \expandafter\gdef\csname ev@placed@#1\endcsname{}%
    \if\relax\detokenize{#3}\relax
      \PackageError{paper-evidence}{No Lean target for #1}%
        {Regenerate the paper's evidence file with scripts/paper_evidence.py.}%
    \else
      % The label establishes the result identity; evidence is printed once
      % in the verification concordance, away from the mathematical argument.
    \fi
  \fi}
% Labels establish identities without adding links to theorem headings.
\newcommand{\ev@hook}[1]{%
  \ifcsname ev@map@#1\endcsname\csname ev@map@#1\endcsname\fi}
\AtBeginDocument{%
  \let\ev@label\label
  \renewcommand{\label}[1]{\ev@label{#1}\ev@hook{#1}}%
  \ifdefined\compatlabel
    \let\ev@compatlabel\compatlabel
    \renewcommand{\compatlabel}[1]{\ev@compatlabel{#1}\ev@hook{#1}}%
  \fi}
\AtEndDocument{%
  \def\do#1{\ifcsname ev@placed@#1\endcsname\else
    \PackageError{paper-evidence}{The evidence mark for #1 was never placed}%
      {Its label does not occur in this paper; regenerate the evidence file.}\fi}%
  \ev@all
  \ifx\ev@rows\@empty\else
    \ifev@newpage\clearpage\fi
    \section*{Verification concordance}
    \addcontentsline{toc}{section}{Verification concordance}
    \begingroup\small
    \begin{longtable}{@{}p{.16\linewidth}@{\hspace{.02\linewidth}}p{.30\linewidth}@{\hspace{.03\linewidth}}p{.16\linewidth}@{\hspace{.02\linewidth}}p{.30\linewidth}@{}}
    \textbf{Statement} & \textbf{Formal proof} & \textbf{Statement} & \textbf{Formal proof}\\\hline
    \endhead
    \ev@rows
    \ifev@second & \\ \fi
    \end{longtable}
    \endgroup
  \fi}
\newcommand{\ev@row}[1]{%
  \hypertarget{verification-result.#1}{}%
  {\scriptsize\hyperref[#1]{\csname ev@name@#1\endcsname}} &
  \ifcsname ev@inline@#1\endcsname
    \csname ev@inline@#1\endcsname
  \else
    {\scriptsize\href{\csname ev@record@#1\endcsname}{Verification record}}%
  \fi
  \ifev@second\global\ev@secondfalse\\
  \else\global\ev@secondtrue &\fi}
\makeatother

% Once per paper: what the marks mean.  #1 is the URL of the paper's evidence
% record.
\newcommand{\evidenceparagraph}[1]{%
  \par\smallskip\noindent
  The verification concordance lists the formal proofs by statement.
  \emph{Lean} links to the supporting declarations; a dagger identifies a
  proof that assumes a named input. \emph{Comparator} links to a recorded
  kernel check against a separately written statement; \emph{pending} means
  that this comparison has not been recorded. The
  \href{#1}{verification record} gives the precise correspondence,
  dependencies and reproducible checks. A row with only a record link has
  no complete formal proof recorded.}

% A plain remark after a result, for what its mark alone cannot say: the input
% a conditional Lean proof assumes, or what is and is not checked for a result
% without a mark.  The skip after the result is replaced by one that cannot
% break, so the remark never starts a page away from its result.
\newcommand{\evidenceremark}[1]{%
  \par\removelastskip\nobreak\vspace{0.3\baselineskip}%
  \noindent{\small #1\par}\vspace{0.15\baselineskip}}
